notes: Child of Henry and Mary Simons; brother or sister of Aaron Simons. Born 25 Jun 1855 in DeKalb County, Indiana; "Ann", aged 6, in 1860 and "Han R.", 15, in 1870, and "Ann Rebecca" in her father's will. Find a Grave lists her as Rebecca Ann Simons Forester.
Died 23 Jun 1904 in Northwest Township, Williams County, Ohio. Married Stephen S. Forester (1854–1923) in 1874; their son was Charles Elmer "Charlie" Forester (1875–1954).
